title: saxifraga fragilis subsp. paniculata
intro: Saxifraga fragilis subsp. paniculata, commonly known as Mountain Saxifrage, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Saxifragaceae family. It is a perennial plant that grows in alpine regions and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Saxifraga fragilis subsp. paniculata include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its use in wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been identified as responsible for its medicinal properties.
